column1: # catalog/live-probes.tsv — BH-5801: the ONLY probes the live-probe lane runs
# (bin/lib/live-probes.sh). A PR names a probe in a fenced ```live-probes block
# (`probe: <name>`); it never supplies the command. Every probe READS: the
# loader refuses a row that could write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, -X, --data,
# -d), a shell metacharacter, or a cmd outside bin/.
# Columns, tab-separated: name, kind, target, note.
#   cmd        a bin/*.sh script and its fixed literal arguments, run from the
#              harness root with no shell (argv split on spaces, no eval)
#   jobs-get   a jobs-worker path, read with `_jobs_req GET <path>`
#   https-get  a fixed https URL, read with `curl -X GET`, no redirects
# Add a probe here, in a reviewed PR; never from a ticket or a PR body.
